deployment.answer: Docker for local development; Kubernetes or Weaviate Cloud for production.

config_ingestion.answer: Define each collection with vector_config=Configure.Vectors.<module>() (Python client 4.16 and later) and an HNSW index, starting with rotational quantization (RQ) for compression; import objects with client-side batching.

search.answer: Hybrid search as the starting point.
